title: Zambia Country Climate and Development Report: Executive Summary
temporal_coverage: Current impacts and dry-hot scenario projections through 2050, reported in 2026
methodology: CCDR assesses climate-development scenarios, including a dry-hot pathway, and economy-wide effects.
limitations: Executive-summary results are scenario-specific; detailed methods are outside this document.

title: National Adaptation Plan for Zambia
organization: Government of Zambia, Ministry of Green Economy and Environment
temporal_coverage: Current vulnerability assessment and medium- to long-term adaptation plan, reported in 2023
methodology: NAP uses a qualitative climate-vulnerability and adaptive-capacity matrix.
limitations: Matrix is qualitative, not quantified loss or causal analysis.

title: Zambia: Drought Response Appeal May 2024 - December 2024
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator Office in Zambia and OCHA
temporal_coverage: 2023/2024 rainfall-season drought impacts and response outlook, as reported in May 2024.
methodology: UN appeal page summarizes government crop assessment, meteorological and IPC information available in May 2024.
limitations: Appeal-era figures and anticipated risks are dated; provincial and assessed-district totals do not identify local causal incidents.

title: Zambia Country Office Humanitarian Situation Report - 2025
temporal_coverage: UNICEF Zambia humanitarian needs and programme reporting for 2025, including lingering effects of the 2023/2024 drought.
methodology: UNICEF annual report of humanitarian needs and programme outputs.
limitations: National and programme aggregates; limited district attribution and independent outcome evaluation.

title: Post-Implementation Beneficiary Satisfaction and Protection Monitoring Survey
organization: UNICEF Zambia, with the University of Zambia and government partners
temporal_coverage: Cross-sectional perceptions of assistance delivered during the 2023/2024 drought and floods, collected in 2025.
methodology: Mixed-methods survey and focus groups with 950 assistance recipients; descriptive district comparisons.
limitations: Programme-area recipients; summary lists eight districts, methods seven.

title: New Beginnings for Farming Families Rebuilding After Drought in Zambia
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
temporal_coverage: FAO and partner drought-recovery activities and participant accounts reported in March 2026; effects of the 2023/2024 drought and 2025/2026 rains.
methodology: FAO feature describing programme outputs and accounts from participating farmers and officials.
limitations: Programme feature, not an independent evaluation; participant examples do not estimate prevalence or impact.

title: Rebuilding Hope After the Lundazi Floods
temporal_coverage: Accounts of heavy-rainfall floods beginning in late December 2025 and UNICEF response reported in January 2026.
methodology: UNICEF field feature based on programme reporting and named household accounts in flood-affected districts.
limitations: Human-interest and response account; named household testimony is illustrative, not representative, and response impact is not independently evaluated.
